messages:
jess: hitting a weird onboarding loop on WSL2. project is on C: mounted in WSL as /mnt/c with drvfs and case=off. when i run `redwoodctl login` it asks for browser auth, writes token to ~/.config/redwood, then immediately asks again when i run `redwoodctl local-serve`. looks like token lookup fails.
sophie: do you have multiple profiles or custom REDWOOD_CONFIG_DIR?
jess: no, default. i noticed `redwoodctl login` writes token path /home/jess/.config/redwood/token but local-serve logs show it's looking in `/home/Jess/.config/redwood/token` (capital J). windows drive mount is case-insensitive so git sometimes checks out with different case.
omar: oh. drvfs on WSL exposes files case-insensitively by default, but the Linux path you pass can differ in case depending on tooling. if our profile-keying uses the full absolute path string as a profile id (case-sensitive) we could end up with two different profile namespaces.
kevin: repro steps? I can try locally.
jess: quick repro: in WSL create dir `mkdir -p /mnt/c/Users/Jess/code/sample` then `ln -s /mnt/c/Users/Jess/code/sample ~/project` and run login in one path and local-serve from the other; sometimes the path casing flips and token not found.
omar: guess: we normalize profile keys with os.UserHomeDir() join and use that as a cookie. On case-insensitive mounts we should canonicalize to lower-case or prefer inode-based stable id. For WSL specifically maybe detect drvfs and use metadata.
sophie: short-term workaround: set REDWOOD_CONFIG_DIR to a path under the Linux-native fs (e.g., ~/, not /mnt/c), or run `git config core.ignorecase true` in the repo to get consistent casing.
kevin: longer-term fix proposals: 1) redwoodctl should normalize paths for profile keys when underlying FS is case-insensitive; 2) add `redwoodctl doctor --casefold` to warn when home/project are on drvfs or other casefold mounts; 3) consider persisting token with a stable machine+user id instead of absolute path.
omar: also add a quick unit test matrix using WSL-like mounts in our e2e runner so we don't regress.
jess: i'll open a PR for a simple normalization (lowercase canonicalization only on detected case-insensitive mounts) and add docs note in onboarding.
dev-bot: created issue DX-1510: "WSL/drvfs case-insensitive mounts cause profile key mismatch -> login loop" assigned to @omar P2.
kevin: thanks jess. can you paste the exact log lines in the issue? that helps.
jess: will do, thanks everyone :raised_hands:
